description: One EstateSales.NET sale in full, by sale ID: name, description, terms, sale type, every scheduled date/time, coordinates, picture count, and the company or seller running it with their phone and page. The street address is included only once EstateSales.NET has published it — estate sales are usually at a private home and the site holds the address back until shortly before the sale.

sale_id.description: EstateSales.NET sale ID, e.g. 5065767 (the `id` from estatesales_search)
